register: bloodboard.register({ id, name, apiVersion: 1, apiMinor?: 0|1|2, requires?: [serviceName…], version, description, timeLimitMs, chooseAction, chooseDecision? })

plan.summary: The engine's preview of an input: legality, steps, exact probabilities.

reachable.summary: Squares a player can reach this activation (plain steps), with Rushes needed.

explore.summary: Every outcome of an input, merged by resulting position, each with a key to continue from.
explore.args: (input, { from?, team?, perspective?, threshold?, maxLeaves?, maxOutcomes?, maxMs?, observations?, features?, decisions?, horizon? })
explore.returns: { ok, value, pTurnover, pTouchdown, outcomes[{key,p,value,…}], rest, exact, unresolvedMass, decisionPolicy, applied }
explore.exact: exact up to `threshold`/`maxLeaves`; the unexpanded mass is reported (`unresolvedMass`, `exact:false`, `approximation`)

evaluate.summary: The built-in evaluation of a position (baseline) and, optionally, the feature vector.
evaluate.exact: n/a (heuristic value; features are exact position facts)

candidates.summary: Legal candidate actions of the ACTIVE team in any position (root or explored key), filtered/paged, with exact probabilities.
candidates.args: ({ from?, team?, families?, players?, targets?, region?, maxRushes?, maxDodges?, minPSuccess?, maxPTurnover?, minPTouchdown?, limit?, offset?, maxPerFamily?, maxPerPlayer?, sort?, precision?, detail?, builtIn?, outcomeValue?, includeIllegal?, maxMs? })
candidates.exact: exact (engine enumeration) unless precision:"fast" (labelled `exact:false`) or "none" (legality only, no probabilities)

threats.tackleZones.summary: Current and projected (one movement) Tackle-Zone coverage per team.
threats.tackleZones.exact: exact facts; projection ignores Dodge/Rush risk

threats.reach.summary: Reachable squares with the Rushes and Dodges of the safest route and its chance.
threats.reach.args: ({ from?, team?, players?, maxRushes?, maxDodges?, limit? })

threats.blitz.summary: Every legal Blitz of the active team on the requested targets with the engine's exact outcome.
threats.blitz.args: ({ from?, team?, targets?, attackers?, squares?, precision?: "exact"|"fast", limit? })

threats.scoring.summary: Direct scoring threats of the active team's ball carrier this Turn.

threats.crowd.summary: Players a single Block could push into the crowd, and exact Block outcomes for attackers already in place.
threats.crowd.exact: exact; chain pushes are not computed (listed)

sequence.summary: Exact evaluation of a sequence of actions by the active team (every step explored in every likely branch).
sequence.args: ({ steps[input], from?, team?, perspective?, maxBranches?, decisions?, … })
sequence.returns: { value, pTurnover, pTouchdown, finals[{key,p,value}], steps[…], exact, … }
sequence.exact: exact over the followed branches; mass left unfollowed is valued where it stands and reported

features.summary: The stable feature vector of a position from a team's perspective.

capabilities.summary: This document: services, limits, schemas, versions.

schema.summary: JSON Schema of a named type.
schema.returns: schema object, or the list of names

progress.summary: Publish a short, factual progress note for the person watching a long decision (shown in the match interface).
progress.args: ({ stage?, headline, evaluating?: string[], ruledOut?: string[], best?: { label, detail?, pTurnover?, pTouchdown?, value? }, fraction? })
progress.exact: n/a (display only: never affects the decision; rate-limited, size-capped)

diagnostics.summary: The diagnostics of this request so far (limits hit, truncations, stale keys …) and the usage counters.

notGenerated: Multiple Block, Bomb throws, Chainsaw and Bombardier star actions (propose them with `input` and check with `plan`); of the special actions only Projectile Vomit is generated
Hail Mary passes and Jumps over a player (propose with `input`)

decisionPolicies.note: Every explore/sequence result states the policy used in `decisionPolicy`. "builtin" resolves in-action decisions (Block die, re-roll, push square, Follow-up …) with the engine's fixed policy and lists its assumptions; the other values enumerate them as branches and solve them (expectimax).

exactness: Match-time probabilities are the engine's exact enumeration. Where mass is left unexpanded (threshold, maxLeaves, maxMs) the result says `exact:false` with `unresolvedMass`; nothing is sampled.
isolation: The module runs in its own worker, reads copies, and never receives a game state, the dice generator, its seed or counter, or any future die. Position keys are request-scoped.
fallback: A thrown error, a timeout, a stale or invalid answer falls back to the built-in coach; the reason is recorded in the move's diagnostics.
